description: This file defines the OrderStatus model class for managing order status records within the OpenCart admin localization module. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving order status data from the database, as well as handling descriptions in multiple languages.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Model class for handling CRUD operations and retrieval of order status data in the database, including descriptions in multiple languages.

methods.name: addOrderStatus
methods.description: Creates a new order status record in the database, including multiple language descriptions.

methods.name: editOrderStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing order status record by deleting the old and inserting new descriptions.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatus
methods.description: Deletes an order status record by its ID.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all order status descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order status record by its ID, considering the current language setting.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves multiple order status records with optional filtering, sorting, pagination, and caching.

methods.name: getTotalOrderStatuses
methods.description: Returns total count of order status records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a new description for an order status in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a given language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches a specific description for an order status and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given order status ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all order status descriptions in a specific language.
